Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
This came up at Crusade Philadelphia the other weekend, and
I couldn't remember if there had been an answer or if it was
supposed to be obvious. ;-)

When you play Charming Lobby, you name the vote you're going
to Charmingly call but don't play that card from your hand
until the Lobby is unblocked. Charming Lobby is itself a
political action. So: do you replace the non-Lobby vote
card? Or do you only replace the Charming Lobby itself, since
when you play the second vote card, the referendum has already
started?

oh yeah, and part two - I'm pretty sure about this one but
I should ask anyway. You can play Cryptic Rider after
replacing cards at the end of a successful referendum, right?
Because it says "after a successful vote" (meaning referendum)?
(I see that Voter Captivation had a ruling issued saying that
this worked for it, but wanted to make sure it also applies to
Cryptic Rider.)

Thanks.

Josh

vekn prince of many rules questions

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Joshua Duffin wrote:
> When you play Charming Lobby, you name the vote you're going
> to Charmingly call but don't play that card from your hand
> until the Lobby is unblocked. Charming Lobby is itself a
> political action. So: do you replace the non-Lobby vote
> card? Or do you only replace the Charming Lobby itself, since
> when you play the second vote card, the referendum has already
> started?

You replace the vote card, since it is played in order to call
the referendum, therefore it must be played before the referendum.

> oh yeah, and part two - I'm pretty sure about this one but
> I should ask anyway. You can play Cryptic Rider after
> replacing cards at the end of a successful referendum, right?
> Because it says "after a successful vote" (meaning referendum)?
> (I see that Voter Captivation had a ruling issued saying that
> this worked for it, but wanted to make sure it also applies to
> Cryptic Rider.)

Yes.
